alt: 兩名玩家互相使眼色，一個偷偷多拿遊戲棋子，另一個替他遮掩，兩人都在作弊。
scene_prompt: 一丘之貉 means people of the same bad conduct, not ordinary friendship or cooperation. Modern tabletop board-game scene with three older children. TWO players clearly collude to CHEAT: one sneaks an extra wooden game token from a hidden stash beneath the table, while the other knowingly hides the action with an upright blank game box and exchanges a sly conspiratorial glance. The third honest player on the opposite side looks puzzled at the board. Both dishonest children's matching sneaky conduct must be visible to viewer; no actual brands, no recognizable copyrighted board games, no numbers, letters, cards with writing, or money. Original simple colored tokens and a plain winding-path game board. Gentle educational humor, not celebrating cheating.
